arm.name: CONSENSUS
arm.why: M9 presence/abstention (evidence-driven, one rule, no threshold): SGGL, except that when the L self gate fails, the G mask is output only if L also claims presence (score_L > 0); otherwise the output is empty and the crop centre is held. Designed from the MOSEv2 DEV-split replay only (157 FP frames removed vs 124 GT-present frames emptied, J 43.4); judged on MOSEv2 conf and VOST.
